themes_detail.label: Park Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints in Greenwich Village parks have spiked 200% this week to 9 complaints versus a 3-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, suggesting an emerging quality-of-life issue affecting neighborhood green spaces.
evidence: 9 park noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.24)
200% spike represents statistically significant deviation with high severity rating
Community board has long-standing request for park renovation/upgrades, suggesting existing infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: Interview park users and nearby residents to identify source of noise (construction, events, gatherings, street performers)
Investigate whether recent weather or seasonal events (spring events, outdoor dining expansion) correlate with spike

themes_detail.label: Mobile Food Vendor Complaints Explode
themes_detail.summary: Mobile food vendor complaints have surged 460% this week to 7 complaints versus a 1.2-complaint weekly average, indicating potential enforcement or permitting issues affecting street vending in the district.
evidence: 7 mobile food vendor complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.8)
460% spike represents highest-severity statistical anomaly among food-related complaints
Vendor enforcement remains in top 10 overall complaint categories (308 over 90 days), suggesting chronic issue
reporting_angles: Determine if complaints are concentrated in specific neighborhoods (Hudson Square, Washington Square Park vicinity) or vendor types
Interview vendors and 311 complainants to understand nature of violations (sanitation, permits, location, operating hours)

themes_detail.label: Flooring/Stairs Building Code Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Interior flooring and stairwell complaints surged 195% this week to 7 complaints versus a 2.4-complaint weekly average, signaling potential housing code violations in residential or mixed-use buildings.
evidence: 7 flooring/stairs complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.16)
195% spike indicates potential widespread building maintenance failures
Community board has standing request for housing inspection programs and code violation correction, suggesting systemic HPD resource gaps
reporting_angles: Identify which buildings or blocks generated multiple complaints this week; assess age and maintenance records
Interview tenants to determine if complaints reflect landlord neglect or deferred maintenance, and connect to broader housing habitability concerns

themes_detail.label: Tree Damage and Deaths Accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Dead/dying tree complaints spiked 967% last week to 4 complaints versus a 0.4-complaint weekly average, and illegal tree damage complaints rose 344% to 5 complaints, indicating an environmental crisis in the district's street tree canopy.
evidence: Dead/dying tree complaints: 4 LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 7.49, highest severity rating)
Illegal tree damage complaints: 5 LAST WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly average (z-score: 4.18)
Community board has filed repeated budget requests for forestry services and street tree maintenance—spanning multiple years—indicating chronic underfunding
reporting_angles: Map tree complaint locations and investigate whether damage is concentrated in particular blocks; assess whether recent construction (1,707 DOB permits filed) or weather events triggered spike
Interview Parks Department about response capacity and funding; determine if tree maintenance backlog has worsened post-pandemic

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retail Complaint Spike
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints jumped 400% last week to 5 complaints versus a 1.0-complaint weekly average, suggesting potential enforcement issues or community friction around the growing number of legal dispensaries in Greenwich Village.
evidence: 5 cannabis retailer complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.0)
400% spike represents statistically significant spike in a newly-regulated category
Suggests emerging friction point as cannabis retail market matures in neighborhood
reporting_angles: Identify which dispensaries generated complaints and nature of violations (odor, loitering, operating hours, youth access)
Interview nearby residents and business owners about impact of cannabis retail expansion on street conditions and foot traffic
